data.name: Real Weapon Names
data.desc:
Renames the fake weapons names to their real counterparts.
The project is meant to be multi-language.

-----

**Game version**

Using this mod with different game versions might bring to untranslated text.
Be patient for future game patch mod compatibility.

-----

**Known compatibility issues**

This mod might not be compatible alongside other mods that changes any text on the screen, making this mod or the other mod not fully working.
Compatibility issues may raise if installed alongside Colored Buffs, Continental Coins, Useful Descriptions or any other mod that changes the Game.locres files.
The game loads the mods according to a PAK order logic.
When more than one mod changes the same file, the file contained in the PAK with higher priority wins, discarding the changes on the same file made by lower priority PAKs.

-----

**Tools**

* LocResUtility, available on GitHub [here](https://github.com/anubi47/LocResUtility).
* repak, available on GitHub [here](https://github.com/trumank/repak).

-----

**Credits**

* Internet Movie Firearms Database ([https://www.imfdb.org/wiki/Payday_3](https://www.imfdb.org/wiki/Payday_3)) for weapon names.
* Superb Soap ([https://x.com/superb_soap](https://x.com/superb_soap)), for Syntax Error DLC, Boys in Blue DLC, Houston Breakout, Fear and Greed weapon names and all mod names.
* korethis, for Syntax Error DLC, Houston Breakout weapon names.
* azzoriff, for reviewing Boys in Blue DLC weapon names

This is an edit of:
* [https://modworkshop.net/mod/44299](https://modworkshop.net/mod/44299) by Nelly
* [https://modworkshop.net/mod/43896](https://modworkshop.net/mod/43896) by HW12Dev

>* Weapons and throwables now have **dynamic echo** sounds that change depending on the environment. (like launch Payday 2)
>* All weapon firing and throwable sounds are replaced with Payday 2 sounds.

>* Bulldozer footsteps, chestplate and visor.
>* Cloaker spawning and idle audio
>* Stealth and combat drones
>* Shield dinks

>* Guard radios
>* Guard radio hacks

>* Ammo pickups
